doc.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25

title: Royal Garden in Chicago: Professor Jones, King Oliver, Lil and Louis
summary: Laurena recalls the emcee Jones and the King Oliver band with Lil, Louis Armstrong and Tubby Hall.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: You were saying about Jones at the Royal College.
Yeah, he's called Professor Jones. I see. He was emcee there for years.
And who was in the band there?

Well, now, they had Lil Armstrong. She wasn't a Lil Armstrong then. I don't know what her name, but later on she married Louis. And King Oliver had the band there then. And Louis was on the, I should say the second trumpet, because King Oliver played the, you know, he was on the first trumpet, I guess. I don't know where they're placed in the band, but King Oliver and Lil, she were at the piano. That's where her and Louis met. I don't know if they met there, but I mean they worked together and they married from there. Because she's from St. Louis and I didn't know her maiden name, but I know she was playing the piano with King Oliver during the time that they were at the Royal Court.
Did you know any of the other fellas in the band?

Oh, now, I know Louis. And then, I did know a fella named Freddie, Freddie Hall. He played the drums. He's from here, big stuff, Tubby. You heard of Tubby? Yeah, sure. Well, I remember Tubby. And another boy, his name is, he played the, he's from here. Now, what is his name? Oh, let me see. He plays in some of the leading bands. Now, I don't, I can't remember his name just now, but I remember Tubby, and I remember Lil, and Louis, and Oliver. Those are all I can remember right now that were in the band at that time.
